name: Naito Jun
source:
A stylist at a hair salon.

He once had a run-in with [url=/c74846]Kajiwara Yoshio[/url] (from [I][url=/v1299]428 ~Fuusa Sareta Shibuya de~[/url][/I], portrayed by the same actor), and they were both shocked to discover they look exactly the same.
